blocks.text: Bank aur financial services blockchain istemal kar ke transactions ko tez aur mehfooz banate hain. Maslan bairon-e-mulk paisa bhejna sust aur mehnga ho sakta hai; blockchain ise tez aur sasta bana deta hai.

blocks.alt: Digital pehchan ka bahao: User apni ID APP se Identity Issuer(s) se tasdeeq (attestations) mangta aur leta hai, unhein Identity Verifier(s) ko jaanch ke liye dikhata hai, aur Identity Hub mein encrypted attestations mehfooz karta hai. App pehchan blockchain par register karti hai aur verifier wahan se pehchan dekhta (lookup) hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 6.4: Bank mein tez aur mehfooz transactions ke liye blockchain (kitab ki Figure 6.4 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Bahao yun hai: idara (Identity Issuer, maslan board ya bank) user ki pehchan ki tasdeeq (attestation) deta hai; user use apni ID app mein rakhta hai aur encrypted copy Identity Hub mein mehfooz karta hai; jab kisi doosre idare (Identity Verifier) ko dikhata hai to woh blockchain par pehchan dekh (lookup) kar foran tasdeeq kar leta hai, kaghazi karrawai ke baghair. Kitab ka caption 'banking mein tez aur mehfooz transactions' kehta hai, lekin tasveer asal mein digital pehchan ki tasdeeq dikhati hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ki Figure 6.4 mein label 'Identity Verifirt (s)' chhapa hai; durust lafz 'Identity Verifier(s)' hai, yani pehchan ki jaanch karne wale idare. Upar ki drawing mein durust label hai.

blocks.title: Class Activity
blocks.text: Is activity mein students dekhenge ke Board of Intermediate and Secondary Education (BISE) ke jaari kiye certificates ki tasdeeq ke liye blockchain kaise istemal ho sakta hai, aur is ka riwayati dasti (manual) tasdeeq se muwazna karenge. Sochiye certificates aam taur par kaise verify hote hain: aap jaari karne wale idare ko darkhwast dete hain, woh haath se certificate jaanch kar us ke asli hone ki tasdeeq karta hai. Yeh kaam waqt leta hai, is mein ghalti ho sakti hai aur dhoke ka khatra hota hai. Ab sochiye blockchain is ko kaise badal sakta hai: idara certificate ki tafseel decentralized ledger par record karta hai. Yeh record na badalne wala (immutable) aur shaffaf hai, is liye koi bhi blockchain dekh kar jaldi aur mehfooz tareeqe se certificate ki tasdeeq kar sakta hai. Groups mein kaam karein, blockchain simulation tool se certificates ki misali tafseel record karein, phir blockchain record dekh kar unhein verify kar ke dikhayein. Blockchain wale aur dasti tareeqe ka farq discuss karein: efficiency (raftar), security, accuracy (durustagi) aur scalability. Aakhir mein aap samajh jayenge ke blockchain certificate ki tasdeeq ko tez, mehfooz aur dhoke se pak kaise banata hai.

blocks.prompt: Class Activity ka namuna: BISE certificate ki dasti aur blockchain tasdeeq ka muwazna.
blocks.explanation: Dasti: board ko darkhwast, staff ke records jaanchne ka intezar; der lagti hai, ghalti aur jaali certificate ka khatra. Blockchain: board har certificate ki tafseel ek dafa na badalne wale ledger par likh deta hai; koi bhi foran jaanch sakta hai; jaali certificate banana mushkil; hazaron darkhwastein bhi aasani se (scalable).
